title: Taking Up a Replacement Payment Arrangement on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan
content:
# Taking Up a Replacement Payment Arrangement on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

**Finance desk request record note.** A customer who cannot meet the ordinary schedule on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan may take up a replacement payment arrangement. Taking it up commits the customer to the arrangement named and to the reduced payment given: the plan record moves into its arrangement standing, records which arrangement is in force, and bills the reduced figure each cycle in place of what it billed before. The balance, the promotional term and the billing history are untouched, and afterwards the customer sees the plan running on the arrangement at the reduced payment.

## Condition on the figure

The reduced payment is worked out only once the scheduled monthly payment the plan record carries answers the balance the plan owes at the handling date.

## The request record

The request is taken on the finance desk's own request record. The replacement schedule is a commitment only the customer can make, so the desk hands the step over rather than performing it.

## Invoking `confirm_hardship_schedule_eb08e7db`

This is a customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `confirm_hardship_schedule_eb08e7db` and hands it to the customer, who runs it themselves; the customer themselves commits to the arrangement and the reduced payment.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format or values |
|---|---|---|
| `financing_plan_id` | The reference number of the promotional financing plan record the customer is taking the arrangement on | An identifier, read from the financing plan lookup before the call and handed to the customer with the tool |
| `reduced_payment_amount` | The payment the customer commits to each cycle while the arrangement runs | In USD as a positive number with 2 decimal places, half-up at the cent, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; an empty value is not accepted |
| `hardship_plan_code` | Which arrangement is being taken up | One of the values below |

**The values `hardship_plan_code` takes.** Use `reduced_payment` when the customer keeps paying every cycle at a smaller figure; `interest_pause` when the arrangement stops interest running rather than lowering the payment; `payment_deferral` when whole cycles are put off to the end rather than paid at a smaller figure; and `none` only when the plan is to run on its ordinary schedule with no arrangement at all.

**Return.** A single confirmation sentence in plain text naming the plan reference, the arrangement now in force and the payment the plan will bill each cycle in USD to two decimal places. That sentence naming the arrangement is what indicates the plan is running on it.

## Points of judgement

- The tool takes the figure it is given; the figure itself is worked out from the plan's records and this desk's published rules before the call.
- The parameters are values the call needs, not questions the desk is required to put to the customer.
